structured_output.summary: One releasable change: add opt-in `stream_detached` plus a `stream_logs` block (skip_handshake, level) and stream metrics to reverse_proxy. Make the response-writer chain (recorder, encode, intercept) treat a 101 as final and write nothing after hijack. Detached streams are tracked in a package-level registry keyed by upstream and, on handler Cleanup, only those whose upstream is absent from the live config are closed. Docs are the Caddyfile doc comment and JSON field comments, since the repo has no separate docs tree.

intents.rationale: No stream_detached option exists; streams are registered per-Handler and closed in Cleanup. Need a registry that outlives the handler and selective closing by upstream.
Default behaviour is already close-on-reload with StreamCloseDelay; it must be preserved while the new branch is added, so the existing cleanupConnections path stays intact and gets regression tests.
No stream_logs block exists. skip_handshake can set the existing caddyhttp.LogSkipVar on the request context so logRequest skips the handshake entry.

Only a DEBUG 'connection closed' log on the handler logger exists. Stream close logs must go to the access loggers (http.log.access, so logger_name access works), at a configurable level defaulting to DEBUG; needs an exported accessor on caddyhttp.Server.

responseRecorder treats 101 as non-final and may buffer it (intercept); encode treats 1xx as non-final; neither blocks writes after Hijack; the proxy's Hijack goes through the recorder's hijackedConn. Make 101 final, never buffered, and no-op writes after hijack.

The extended CONNECT path (h2ReadWriteCloser) exists and must keep working, and HTTP/1.1 upgrades must work in detached mode; the registry change touches this code, so keep it working and cover it by integration tests.
metrics.go only has upstreams_healthy; add active gauge, closed counter by result, duration histogram, and bytes counters, recorded once per stream in a single finalizer.
New JSON fields need doc comments and the Caddyfile syntax comment needs the new subdirectives; there is no separate docs tree.
Add integration tests with real server and clients (gorilla-free: raw net/http upgrade and golang.org/x/net/http2 for extended CONNECT) in caddytest/integration.
Unit tests for the recorder, encode, intercept, registry, metrics, and Caddyfile parsing.

criteria.text: With stream_detached set, an upgraded stream stays open after a reload whose config still contains its upstream, and is closed after a reload that removes that upstream.
Caddyfile `stream_detached` and JSON `stream_detached: true` both set Handler.StreamDetached; it defaults to false.
Without stream_detached, an upgraded stream is closed on reload immediately, or after stream_close_delay when configured.
stream_logs { skip_handshake } parses in Caddyfile and JSON; when set the handshake request is not access-logged, by default it is.

A stream close log entry is written to the access logger (selectable with logger_name access) at the configured level, DEBUG by default, including after the config that created it was reloaded in detached mode.
ResponseRecorder, encode and intercept treat a 101 as the final response, never buffer it, and perform no header or body writes after Hijack; the proxy copies on the raw connection.
WebSocket/Upgrade streams work end to end through encode and through intercept with handle_response, with access logging enabled.
An HTTP/2 extended CONNECT websocket through reverse_proxy relays data, and an HTTP/1.1 upgrade works with stream_detached.
Metrics for active streams, closed-by-result, duration, and bytes to/from the backend are updated exactly once per stream, and the active gauge returns to zero.
Caddyfile syntax comment and JSON field comments document stream_detached, stream_logs, skip_handshake and the log level.
Integration tests exist for reload survive/close in each mode, extended CONNECT over h2, upgrades through encode and intercept, and detached streams with access logging.
Unit tests cover each changed unit (recorder, encode, intercept, registry/cleanup, metrics, caddyfile parsing).

tasks.summary: Order: (1) in caddyhttp, make responseRecorder treat 101 as final/unbuffered and no-op writes after Hijack; add the Server accessor for access loggers; (2) same hijack/101 hardening in encode and intercept; (3) add reverseproxy streams registry (package-level, keyed by upstream dial, live-upstream refcount maintained in Provision/Cleanup), StreamDetached, StreamLogs{SkipHandshake, Level} fields, Caddyfile parsing, and cleanupConnections branching (detached: close only streams whose upstream is no longer live; default path unchanged); (4) rewrite handleUpgradeResponse to account each stream once via a single finalizer (metrics, close log to access loggers) and set LogSkipVar when skip_handshake; (5) add metrics; (6) tests and caddyfile_adapt fixture, then docs in comments.
